focus_area: Frontend display-state derivation, button props, EmptyState/action-row structure, styled components, copy, and section integrity in JobCriteriaSection.tsx / jobCriteriaTiers.ts / JobSetupAiSettings.tsx

findings.title: Unused `history` prop threaded into JobCriteriaSection
findings.description: Props declares `history: any` (line 22) and JobSetupAiSettings.tsx:107 passes `history={props.history}`, but JobCriteriaSection destructures only `{ job }` (line 25) and never reads `history`. Navigation to the job description is done with a react-router `<Link>` (line 40, adjudicated-correct), so the `history` prop is dead. No runtime consequence; pure dead code.
findings.recommendation: Drop `history` from the Props interface and from the JSX usage at JobSetupAiSettings.tsx:107, or use it — no behavioral change either way.

findings.title: `isInFlight` includes raw `isFetching`, so any background refetch briefly disables the Regenerate button
findings.description: `isInFlight = isPayloadStatusInFlight || isFetching` (line 70) drives `loading`/`disabled` on the Regenerate button (lines 160-161). `isFetching` is true during ANY query refetch, not only the post-regenerate refetch. `useAiJobCriteria` (useAiJobCriteria.ts:21-25) does not set `refetchOnWindowFocus: false` (unlike several sibling hooks, e.g. useOrganizationAiCreditPurchase.ts:11), so a window refocus refetch will momentarily put the button into loading+disabled with no extraction in flight. This is spec-compliant per SPEC 8.3 ('OR ... the query is refetching') and is purely cosmetic (no data loss / wrong result), but is the only behavior worth noting. `displayState` correctly uses `isPayloadStatusInFlight` (not `isFetching`), so card/empty-state content does not flicker during refetch.
findings.recommendation: Optional: gate the button on the mutation/payload status only (e.g. `isPayloadStatusInFlight`) or set `refetchOnWindowFocus: false` on the query, to avoid the transient disable on unrelated refetches. Non-blocking.
